slides.title: Initialization Order
slides.prompt: In what order are class member variables initialized in C++?
options: In the order they are declared in the class definition
In the order they appear in member initializer list
slides.correctAnswer: In the order they are declared in the class definition

slides.title: Destructor Naming
slides.prompt: Fill in symbol used before class name to define a destructor.

slides.title: Destructor Characteristics
slides.prompt: Which statement about C++ destructors is true?
options: They take no parameters and cannot be overloaded
A class can have multiple overloaded destructors
They can return integer status codes
They must be manually called for stack objects
slides.correctAnswer: They take no parameters and cannot be overloaded

Foo(int x) : ___(x, 0) {}
